field_text_formatted.value: On a local copy of druxtjs.org, a warm docs page went from 11 calls to Drupal to none. A cold crawl, every page visited once, went from 438 calls on 0.24.0 to 157, a third of them on the first page, where schema refresh reads Drupal's displays. Only successful anonymous responses are kept, so a signed-in visitor still reaches Drupal, and a page published after someone saw its 404 shows straight away.
